items.headline: NFL Week 3's best arrivals, led by Jalen Hurts
items.description: NFL stars continue to turn game-day arrivals into their own weekly fashion showcase.

items.headline: Giants acquire JJ McCarthy from Vikings
items.description: McCarthy is headed to New York in exchange for a 2027 fifth-round pick and will initially back up Jameis Winston.

items.headline: J.J. McCarthy traded to Giants: Will he succeed in New York?
items.description: With Jaxson Dart out for the season, the Giants dealt a fifth-round pick to Minnesota for McCarthy. But does this move the needle for New York? Can it work?

items.headline: Vikings' Justin Jefferson has ankle sprain, could play this week
items.description: Vikings star wide receiver Justin Jefferson has an ankle sprain, according to the MRI performed Monday, and there's a chance he'll be able to play Sunday against the Dolphins.

items.headline: McCarthy exits Vikings as one of franchise's biggest draft busts
items.description: J.J. McCarthy was the No. 10 pick in 2024 but played only 10 games before being traded to the Giants on Monday.

items.headline: NFL trade deadline grades: J.J. McCarthy to the Giants
items.description: Can J.J. McCarthy improve the Giants' QB situation? Did the Vikings get enough back? We're grading NFL trades ahead of November's deadline.
